paths.description: Homepage/listing and mandatory age-gate archetype; primary browse/search entry.

findings.summary: The interface does not follow the user’s dark color preference.
findings.evidence: The dark/contrast screenshot remains the same light gray and white treatment, and computed html color-scheme is normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide dark surface/text tokens under prefers-color-scheme.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use view transitions.
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS/DOM inspection found no view-transition declarations or transition names across the MPA templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document or same-document View Transitions for navigation where motion adds continuity, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long listing pages provide no scroll-state feedback.
findings.evidence: The listing DOM/CSS has no scroll-state container query or progress/scroll affordance while the home page presents a long grid.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scrollability cue or scroll-state-aware header treatment without obscuring content.

findings.summary: The mandatory age gate is implemented as a custom div overlay rather than a dialog.
findings.evidence: DOM identifies #disclaimer_message and #disclaimer_background, but no dialog or role=dialog is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a modal <dialog> with an accessible name, focus containment, Escape policy appropriate to the legal gate, and explicit consent actions.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport breakpoints rather than container-level adaptation.
findings.evidence: Computed styles report container-type: normal and CSS inspection found no container-query support on the listing/header components.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable cards and header groups containment and adapt them with @container where their available space, not the viewport, controls layout.

findings.summary: Several visible controls lose focus indication and are below recommended touch size.
findings.evidence: The focus probe found search/header buttons with outline none and controls measuring 28×29 or 34×28 CSS px; the age-gate controls retained browser outlines.
findings.suggestedFix: Use :focus-visible styles with strong contrast and enlarge interactive hit areas to at least 44×44 CSS px where practical.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails automated accessibility checks.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast scored 0 and reported a failing node; the issue persists in the emulated higher-contrast capture.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG contrast and verify normal, dark, and high-contrast conditions.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 7.1 s LCP (performance 0.57); the trace measured 2.74 s LCP under a separate desktop capture.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the actual LCP resource, trim render-path work, and retest on mobile throttling and representative templates.

findings.summary: The mobile listing shifts substantially during load.
findings.evidence: The layout primitive observed CLS 0.1936, while 99 of 100 images lacked width/height attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve thumbnail space with width/height or aspect-ratio and avoid late layout changes around the gate and listing.

findings.summary: The page eagerly transfers too many heavy, legacy resources.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 123 requests and 1.83 MB, including 108 images; 90 below-fold images were not lazy, all 100 lacked srcset, 99 used legacy formats, and a main script was 517 KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold thumbnails, add responsive modern image sources, and split/defer non-critical JavaScript.

findings.summary: Thumbnail images have no alternative text.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 98 of 100 images without alt; Lighthouse image-alt scored 0 with 100 items.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful linked thumbnails concise alt text, or use empty alt only where adjacent accessible link text fully duplicates the image purpose.

findings.summary: Primary templates lack a coherent heading structure.
findings.evidence: The home, category, account, and video DOM captures contain no h1; the home probe found no headings at all.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive h1 per template and organize sections with ordered headings and landmarks.

findings.summary: Canonical and structured metadata are inconsistent across public templates.
findings.evidence: Home, category, account, and video DOM captures have no canonical link; JSON-LD/Open Graph were present on the video but absent on home/category.
findings.suggestedFix: Add self-referential canonicals and template-appropriate structured/social metadata that matches visible content.

findings.summary: Defensive response headers and CSP are weak.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows no HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, or Permissions-Policy; CSP allows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval and a broad origin set.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, nosniff, Permissions-Policy, and a nonce/hash-based CSP; reduce allowed origins and remove unsafe-eval.

findings.summary: Authentication does not expose a modern passkey path.
findings.evidence: The account template offers password and federated login only; DOM inspection found no WebAuthn/passkey affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and sign-in alongside existing methods, initiated from explicit user actions.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields omit correct autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: The login email and password inputs have no autocomplete attributes; disabled password-change fields use new-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Set autocomplete=username on the email/login field and autocomplete=current-password on the sign-in password field.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bandwidth and computation.
findings.evidence: The page transfers 731 KB across 108 images; 90 below-fold images are eager, 100 lack responsive sources, and 99 use JPEG/PNG/GIF rather than modern formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP thumbnails, lazy-load below-fold media, and cap initial-grid requests to visible content.
